neighbours.label: the subject of a 'what X do(es)' question about what something does (what these genes / it / they do)
fire: Researchers are still trying to work out what these enzymes do inside the cell.

Ask the engineer what that valve does before you touch it.

quiet: Researchers are still trying to purify these enzymes from the cell.
The manual never mentions the color of this button.
Most people have two kidneys and a single liver.

notes: card: ' they' x11, ' it' x7, ' genes' in 'find out what they do'; the output suppresses function/role/purpose. Probe: 'what these proteins do' 0.61, 'what it does' 0.25, but 'where these proteins go' leaks 0.30, so near misses avoid the 'what/where X' frame.
